chunks: And from him, from Ya'qub, from Ibn Abi Najran, from the one who mentioned him, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)
That he used to sleep between two maidservants.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling or practice regarding an Imam sleeping with his maidservants?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the natural and unpretentious domestic habits of the Imams, illustrating that their private conduct with concubines (jawari) followed common social norms of the era. Cited in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* under the chapter of childbirth and 'aqiqah, it serves to contextualize the lineage and birth circumstances of children born from these unions, reinforcing the legitimacy of offspring from slave-women in Shia jurisprudence.
